cyangwa igikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose
bikenewe, hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n'amabwiriza.

articles.heading: Itangwa ry'ubusabe (1) Hakurikijwe ingingo ya 11, gusaba ko Ibiro bya ARIPO bitanga uburenganzira
articles.text:
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa bigomba gukorwa na:
(a) uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa; cyangwa
(b) umukorera ;
ku Biro bya ARIPO cyangwa ku Rwego
rubishinzwe rw'igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano y'Inyongera.
(2) Ubusabe bwatanzwe ku Rwego
rubishinzwe rw'Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano y'Inyongera hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu gika cya (1) bufatwa
nk'ubwatanzwe ku Biro bya ARIPO kuri
iyo itariki.
(3) Iyo ubusabe butanzwe ku Rwego
rw'Igihugu, Urwego rugomba :
(a) kugenzura mbere na mbere ko ubusabe
bukubiyemo amakuru y’ibanze ateganywa
n'amabwiriza; no
(b) kubushyikiriza Ibiro bya ARIPO, mu
gihe cy'ukwezi kumwe uhereye ku munsi
rwakiriyeho ubwo busabe.
(4) Ubusabe bugomba kuba bukubiyemo
amakuru ateganywa n'amabwiriza, cyane
cyane:
(a) izina ry'uwatanze ubusabe, aho
abarizwa n'andi makuru akenewe, harimo
ajyanye n'umuntu wavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa, niba atari
nyir'ubwite watanze ubusabe, n'izina
ry'umukorera, aho abarizwa n'andi makuru
akenewe, mu gihe ari nyir'ubwite watanze
ubusabe;
(b) ibiranga icyiciro cy'ubwoko bw'ibimera
(Izina ry'ikimera n'izina rusange);
(c) izina ryifujwe ku bwoko cyangwa izina
ry'agateganyo ;
(d) Ibisobanuro mu bya tekiniki ku bwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa;
(e) amakuru ajyanye n'ubusabe ndetse
n'itangwa ry'uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa byakozwe mbere ku bwoko
bumwe n'ubwo;
(f) Itariki ubwoko bwagurishirijweho
cyangwa bweguriweho abandi mu rwego
rwo kububyaza umusaruro hakurikijwe

articles.heading: Itariki yo gutangiraho ubusabe Itariki itangiweho ubusabe bw'uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
articles.text:
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa ni itariki
yakiriweho ubusabe bwujuje ibisabwa
haseguriwe kwishyura amafaranga
ateganyijwe.
Uri mu Masezerano mpuzamahanga
agamije kurengera ubwoko bushya
bw'ibihingwa ("ubusabe bwa mbere")
agomba, mu gihe atanze ubusabe bwo
guhabwa uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya ku bwoko bumwe n'ubwo,
guhita ashyikiriza ARIPO ubwo busabe.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo gusaba mbere (1) Uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa watanze ubusabe bwo
articles.text:
kurengera ubwoko bw'igihingwa nk'uko
bisabwa, mu Gihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano y'Inyongera cyangwa ku Biro
bya ARIPO cyangwa ku Rwego
rw'igihugu rubishinzwe, agira
uburenganzira bwo kwitabwaho mbere
mbere mu gihe cy'amezi cumi n’abiri
uhereye ku itariki yatangiweho ubusabe
bwa mbere, hatabariwemo umunsi ubusabe
bwatangiweho.
(2) Kugira ngo uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa agire uburenganzira
bwo kwitabwaho mbere, agomba, mu
busabe bwatanzwe mu buryo butaziguye
ku Biro bya ARIPO cyangwa ku Rwego
rw'igihugu, gusaba guhabwa
uburenganzira ku busabe bwatanzwe
mbere.
(3) Ku bw'igika cya (1), Ibiro bya ARIPO
bisaba uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa gutanga, mu gihe kitarenze
amezi atatu uhereye ku itariki yatangiweho
ubusabe, ibi bikurikira:
(a) inyandukuro z'inyandiko zakoreshejwe
mu busabe bwa mbere, zemejwe
n'ubuyobozi yatanzemo ubwo busabe bwa
mbere; na
(b) indobanurwa cyangwa ibindi
bimenyetso bigaragaza ko ubwoko bufite
ubusabe bubiri ari bumwe.
(4) Uhereye ku itariki yarangiriyeho igihe
gihabwa uwasabye mbere, uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa ahabwa
igihe cy'imyaka ibiri cyangwa agahabwa
igihe gihagije nyuma yuko ubusabe bwa
mbere butakiriwe cyangwa bwakuwemo,
mu rwego rwo kugeza ku Biro bya ARIPO
amakuru ayo ari yo yose, inyandiko izo ari
zo zose cyangwa ibikoresho bikenewe
kugira ngo bikorerwe isuzumwa
riteganywa mu ngingo ya 17.
(5) Ibintu byabaye mu gihe giteganyijwe
mu gika cya (1), nko gutanga ubundi
busabe cyangwa gutangaza cyangwa
gukoresha ubwoko bw'igihingwa
bwatangiwe ubusabe bwa mbere,
ntibigomba:
(a) kuba impamvu yo kutakira ubusabe
bundi bushya; no
(b) gutuma habaho uburenganzira bw’undi
muntu.
UMUTWE V: ITANGAZWA
RY'AMAKURU

articles.heading: Itanganzwa ry'amakuru (1) Ibiro bya ARIPO bitangaza mu gihe gisanzwe kizwi Ikinyamakuru cya ARIPO
articles.text:
gikubiyemo amakuru akurikira:
(a) Ubusabe bwo guhabwa uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa;
(b) Amakuru ajyanye n'amazina y'amoko
mashya y'ibihingwa;
(c) ubusabe bwo guhabwa uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa bwakuwemo;
(d) Ubusabe bwo guhabwa uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa butakiriwe;
(e) Uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa bwatanzwe;
(f) uko abantu bagiye bahinduka (abatanze
ubusabe, abafite uburenganzira
n'abakorera abafite uburenganzira); na
(g) uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa
bwateshejwe agaciro, bwasubijwe,
bwaseshwe n'ubwarangije igihe.
(2) Nta makuru y'ibanga, nk'uko bigaragara
mu mpapuro zisaba zigomba kuzuzwa,
ashobora gutangazwa bitemewe mu
nyandiko n'usaba cyangwa ufite
uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bw’igihingwa.

articles.heading: Gutambamira (1) Umuntu uwo ari we wese wifuza gutambamira itangwa ry'uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
articles.text:
bw'igihingwa ashobora gusa kurigeza ku
Biro bya ARIPO, rifite ibisobanuro
biryumvikanisha, nyuma yo kwishyura
ikiguzi giteganyijwe, ari uko hatangajwe
ubusabe bw'uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa, igihe icyo ari cyo cyose
mbere yuko butangwa, hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu gaka ka (a) k'igika cya (2)
cy'ingingo ya 39.
(2) Umuntu uwo ari we wese wifuza
gutambamira itangwa ry'uburenganzira
nk'uko bivugwa mu gika cya (1) agomba
kubisaba mu nyandiko, agaragaza
impamvu yo kutabutanga cyangwa yo
kubutanga hakurikijwe ibiteganywa mu
ngingo ya 6, iya 7, iya 8, iya 9, iya 10 n'iya
11, mu gihe kitarenze amezi 3 uhereye ku
itariki yatangarijweho izina ry'ubwoko
bw'igihingwa ryatanzwe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 27.
UMUTWE WA VI: ISUZUMA
HAGAMIJWE GUTANGA
UBURENGANZIRA
BW'UWAVUMBUYE UBWOKO
BUSHYA BW'IBIMERA

articles.heading: Gusuzuma ubusabe (1) Ibiro bya ARIPO bigomba
articles.text:
(a) gusuzuma ubusabe mu rwego rwo
kugaragaza niba, hamwe n'inyandiko
zijyana na bwo, byujuje ibisabwa kugira
ngo habeho kurengerwa hakurikijwe

articles.heading: Isuzuma ku itandukaniro, ku miterere imwe no ku kudahindagurika (1) Hakurikijwe ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya
articles.text:
17 mu gaka ka (d) k'igika cya (1), Ibiro bya
ARIPO, mu rwego rw'isuzuma no
kubahiriza ibisabwa bivugwa mu ngingo
ya 8, iya 9 n'iya 10, bishobora:
(a) gukora isuzuma byifashishije ikigo icyo
ari cyo cyose kibifitiye ububasha cyo mu
Gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyangwa
cyo mu gihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kigize
umuryango mpuzamahanga ushinzwe
kurengera amoko y'ibihingwa,
cyatoranyijwe n'Inama y’Ubutegetsi; no
(b) kugendera ku byavuye mu igerageza
ryakozwe n'Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano cyangwa n'igihugu icyo ari
cyo cyose kigize umuryango
mpuzamahanga ushinzwe kurengera
amoko y'ibihingwa cyatoranyijwe n'Inama
y’Ubutegetsi.
(2) Uburyo bwo gushyira mu bikorwa
ibivugwa muri iyi ngingo bugomba
gusobanurwa mu mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Gutanga no kudatanga uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa (1) Mu gihe ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa
articles.text:
bwujuje ibisabwa mu bijyanye n'ubushya,
itandukaniro n'uguhuza imiterere
n'imimerere no kudahindagurika
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 7, iya 8, iya 9 n'iya
10 kandi izina ryahawe ubwoko
bw'igihingwa rigikwiriye, Ibiro bya
ARIPO bitanga uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa, mu gihe ibyo bisabwa
bituzuye, Ibiro bya ARIPO byanga
ubusabe.
(2) haseguriwe ingingo ya 4 igika cya (1),
mu rwego rw'uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa bwatanzwe, Ibiro bya
ARIPO bigomba:
(a) guha uwabusabye icyemezo
cy'uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa; no
(b) kwandika mu gitabo amakuru ajyanye
n'ubusabe; no
(c) gutangaza amakuru ajyanye n'itangwa
ry'ubwo burenganzira ashobora kuba
ateganywa n'amabwiriza.
(3) Mu gihe isuzuma rigaragaje ko izina
ryatanzwe ku bwoko bw'igihingwa
ridashobora kwandikwa, Ibiro bya ARIPO
bishobora gusaba usaba mu nyandiko
gutanga irindi zina mu gihe cy'amezi atatu,
cyangwa mu gihe kirenga gishobora
gutangwa n'Umuyobozi Mukuru bitewe
n'impamvu zumvikana, mu gihe
bitubahirijwe ubusabe ntibwemerwa.
(4) Ubusabe ntibwemerwa mu gihe
bigaragaye ko:
(a) Usaba atemerewe gutanga ubusabe
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 11;
(b) usaba atatanze, mu gihe giteganyijwe,
ibyo yasabwe n'Ibiro bya ARIPO mu buryo
bwemewe n'amategeko, cyane cyane iyo:
(i) amakuru yatanzwe arimo amakosa
cyangwa atuzuye;
(ii) ubusabe butujuje ibisabwa:
(c) ubwoko bw'igihingwa usaba avuga
butujuje ibisabwa biteganywa mu ngingo
ya 7, iya 8, iya 9 n'iya 10;
(d) usaba yanze cyangwa atashoboye
gutanga izina ryakwemerwa;
(e) usaba atishyuye ikiguzi giteganyijwe.
(5) Kuri buri busabe butemewe, Ibiro bya
ARIPO bigomba:
(a) kumenyesha mu nyandiko uwatanze
ubusabe icyemezo byafashe; kandi
(b) kwandika mu gitabo amakuru ajyanye
n'ubusabe; no
(c) gutanganza imenyesha ryo kutakira
ubusabe.
(6) Ibiro bya ARIPO ntibigomba:
(a) kwanga gutanga uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa kubera ko ubwo bwoko
bw'igihingwa butigeze busabirwa
kurengerwa cyangwa butemerewe
kurengerwa mu kindi Gihugu kitari mu
bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
cyangwa kitari mu bigize umuryango
mpuzamahanga; cyangwa
(b) kugabanya igihe uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa bumara kubera ko igihe
cyagenewemo kurengera ubwo bwoko
bw'igihingwa, mu kindi gihugu cyangwa
mu bihugu bigize umuryango
mpuzamahanga, cyarangiye.

articles.heading: Kurengerwa by'agateganyo (1) Amasezerano y'Inyongera ateganya kurindwa by'agateganyo hagati y'igihe
articles.text:
ubusabe bw'uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa butangarijweho n'igihe
butangiweho mu rwego rwo kurengera
inyungu z'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa.
(2) Ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa
bwavumbuwe bufatwa nk'ubwemerewe
kurindwa by'agateganyo mu gihe
giteganywa mu gika cya (1) kandi
uwabuvumbuye aba afite uburenganzira
nibura ku bihembo bigenerwa
umuvumbuzi ku buryo bumwe n'ibihabwa
umuntu uwo ari we wese wahawe
uburenganzira kandi wujuje ibisabwa
kugira ngo atange uruhushya rutangwa
n'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa nk'uko biteganywa n'igingo
ya 21.
(3) ikirego icyo ari cyo cyose kijyanye
n'ibyo mu gihe cyo kurengerwa
by'agateganyo gishobora gutangwa gusa
nyuma y'itangwa ry'uburenganzira.
UMUTWE WA VII:
UBURENGANZIRA
BW'UWAVUMBUYE UBWOKO
BUSHYA BW'IGIHINGWA

articles.heading: Aho uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa bukoreshwa (1) Haseguriwe ingingo ya 22 n'iya 23, ku
articles.text:
bijyanye n'ibikoreshwa mu butubuzi
bw'ubwoko bw'igihingwa burengewe,
uruhushya rutangwa n'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa rusabwa ku
bikorwa bikurikira:
(a) kubihinga cyangwa kongera gukora
ibindi bimeze nka byo (gutubura);
(b) kubitunganya hagamijwe kubikoresha
mu butubuzi ;
(c) kubishyira ku isoko;
(d) kubigurisha cyangwa kubikoresha mu
bundi buryo bw'ubucuruzi;
(e) kubyohereza hanze y'igihugu;
(f) kubyinjiza imbere mu gihugu
(g) kubihunika hagamijwe kimwe mu
bivugwa haruguru mu gaka ka (a) kugeza
mu ka (f).
(2) Uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa ashobora kugira ibyo asaba
cyangwa abuza ku ruhushya atanze.
(3) Haseguriwe ingingo ya 22 n'iya 23,
ibikorwa bivugwa mu gaka ka (a) kugeza
mu ka (f) tw'igika cya (1), ku bijyanye na:
(a) ibyasaruwe, harimo igihingwa cyose
n'ibikigize, byabonetse binyuze mu
gukoresha nta ruhushya ibikoreshwa mu
butubuzi bw'ubwoko bw'igihingwa
burengewe bisaba gutangirwa uruhushya,
keretse uwavumbuye ubwo bwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa adafite uburyo bwumvikana
bwo gukoresha uburenganzira afite ku
bijyanye n'ibyo bikoreshwa mu butubuzi;
(b) ibyakozwe, mu buryo butaziguye, mu
byasaruwe mu bwoko bw'igihingwa
burengewe bivugwa mu biteganywa mu
gaka ka (a) binyuze mu gukoresha nta
ruhushya ibyo byasaruwe bisaba
gutangirwa uruhushya n'uwavumbuye
ubwo bwoko bushya bw'igihingwa, keretse
adafite uburyo bwumvikana bwo
gukoresha uburenganzira afite ku bijyanye
n'ibyo byasaruwe.
(4) Ibiteganywa mu gika cya (1), (2) n'icya
(3) byubahrizwa kandi na none ku bijyanye
na:
(a) amoko y'ibihingwa akomoka ahanini ku
bwoko bw'igihingwa burengewe, mu gihe
ubwo bwoko bw'igihingwa burengewe na
bwo ubwabwo budafite ubwo
bukomokaho; na
(b) amoko y'ibihingwa adafite aho
atandukaniye n'ubwoko bw'igihingwa
burengewe mu buryo bugaragara,
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 8; na
(c) amoko y'ibihingwa agira umusaruro
usaba guhora hakoreshwa ubwoko
bw'igihingwa burengewe.
(5) Ku bw'agaka ka (a) k'ingingo ya (4),
ubwoko bw'igihingwa bufatwa ahanini
nk'ubukomoka ku bundi bwoko
bw'igihingwa ("inkomoko y'ubwoko
bw'igihingwa") iyo:
(a) ahanini buturuka ku nkomoko
y'ubwoko bw'igihingwa cyangwa ku
bwoko bw'igihingwa buturuka ubwabwo
ku nkomoko y'ubwoko bw'igihingwa,
ariko bugakomeza kugumana imimerere
n'imiterere ahanini ituruka ku bigize
inkomoko y'ubwoko bw'igihingwa
byihariye cyangwa ihuzwa ry'ibiyigize;
kandi
(b) butandukanye n'inkomoko y'ubwoko
bw'igihingwa mu buryo bugaragara; ndetse
(c) usibye itandukaniro rituruka mu gukura
ubwoko bw'igihingwa ku bundi, busa neza
n'inkomoko y'ubwoko bw'igihingwa mu
mimerere n'imiterere ituruka ku bigize
inkomoko y'ubwoko bw'igihingwa
byihariye cyangwa ihuzwa ry'ibiyigize.
(6) Amoko y'ibihingwa ahanini akomoka
ku bindi bihingwa ashobora kubaho,
nk'urugero, binyuze mu kurobanura
ayihinduye yo ubwayo cyangwa bitewe
n'ibyayakoreweho, cyangwa ihindagurika
ry'ibiyagize bitewe n'uburyo yahinzwemo,
mu kurobanura ubwoko butandukanye
by'umwimerere n'ayandi bituruka ku
nkomoko imwe y'ubwoko bw'igihingwa,
mu guhuza ubwoko bw'igihingwa
n'inkomoko yabwo cyangwa mu kongera
uturemagingo dushya mu tugize inkomoko
y'ubwoko bw'igihingwa.

articles.heading: Amarengayobora ku burenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihigwa (1) Uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
articles.text:
ubwoko bushya bw'gihingwa
ntibukoreshwa:
(a) ku bikorwa byakozwe n'umuntu mu
rwego rwo kubwikoreshereza, kandi atari
ku mpamvu z'ubucuruzi; no
(b) ku bikorwa byakozwe ku mpamvu
z'ubushakashatsi; na
(c)ku bikorwa byakozwe mu rwego rwo
kurobanura andi moko kandi, haseguriwe
ibiteganywa mu gika cya (4) cy'ingingo ya
21, ku bikorwa bivugwa mu gika cya (1),
icya (2) n'icya (3) by'ingingo ya 21, ku
bijyanye n'ayo moko yandi.
(2) Hatitawe ku ngingo ya 21,
uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa ntibukoreshwa
n'umuhinzi, mu buryo bwumvikana kandi
butabangamira inyungu ufite
uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa yemererwa
n'amategeko, mu rwego rwo gutubura ku
nyungu ze bwite, ukoresha umusaruro
yakuye mu buhinzi yikoreye ku giti cye, ku
bwoko bw'igihingwa burengewe cyangwa
ku bwoko bw'igihingwa buvugwa mu gika
cya (4) cy'ingingo ya 21, hagendewe ku
rutonde rw'ibihingwa cyangwa imboga
rugenwa n'Inama y’Ubutegetsi abahinzi
basanzwe bafite uburyo babikamo imbuto
zabyo mu Bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano, kandi rudakubiyemo imbuto
zo kurya, ibihingwa by'imitako, izindi
mboga zitari ku rutonde n'ibiti
by'ishyamba.
(3) Uburyo bwo gushyira mu bikorwa
ibiteganywa mu gika cya (2), nk'ibyiciro
bitandukanye by'ibihembo by'abavumbuzi
bitangwa n'abahinzi bakora ubucuruzi
buciriritse n'abakora ubucuruzi bwagutse
ndetse n'amakuru abahinzi baha
uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa, bigomba guteganywa mu
mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Aho uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa burangirira (1) Uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
articles.text:
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa
ntibukoreshwa ku bikorwa bijyanye n'ibyo
ari byo byose byavuye ku bwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa burengewe cyangwa ku
bwoko bw'igihingwa buvugwa mu gika
cya (4) cy'ingingo ya 21 byagurishijwe
cyangwa bigacuruzwa mu bundi buryo
n'uwabuvumbuye cyangwa n'uwo
yabyemereye ku butaka bw'Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y'Inyongera,
cyangwa ibyo ari byo byose bikomoka kuri
ibyo byabuvuyeho, keretse ari uko icyo
gikorwa:
(a) kigamije kongera gutubura bundi
bushya ubwo bwoko bw'igihingwa
buvugwa ; cyangwa
(b) kigamije kohereza ibikomoka kuri
ubwo bwoko bw'igihingwa, bikoreshwa
mu kubutubura, mu gihugu kitarengera
amoko y'ibihingwa, amatsinda y'amoko
y'ibihingwa cyangwa inkomoko
z'ibihingwa bibarizwamo ubwo bwoko,
keretse iyo ibibukomokaho byoherejwe
hanze nta kindi bigamije uretse kuribwa.
(2) Ku bw'igika cya (1), "ibibukomokaho"
ku bijyanye n'ubwoko bw'igihingwa,
bisobanura :
(a) ubwoko ubwo ari bwo bwose
bw'ibikoreshwa mu butubuzi; na
(b) ibyasaruwe, harimo igihingwa cyose na
kimwe mu bikigize; na
(c) ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose gikomoka mu
buryo butaziguye ku byasaruwe.

articles.heading: Ikumira ku burenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa (1) Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
cyemerera uruhushya rutegetswe
uwarusabye iyo gusa ari ku mpamvu
z'inyungu rusange.
(2) Mu gihe Urwego rw'Igihugu rwemeye
gutanga uruhushya rutegetswe hakurikijwe
igika cya (1), rugomba kugaragaza
ibikorwa birebwa n'urwo ruhushya ndetse
no kugaragaza ibisabwa byumvikana
bigomba kuba bikubiyemo ubwishyu
buhura neza n'igihembo gikwiye kigomba
guhabwa uwavumbuye ubwo bwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa.
(3) Amabwiriza agomba kugaragaza
uburyo ibiteganywa mu gika cya (1) n'icya
(2) bigomba gushyirwa mu bikorwa.

articles.heading: Ingamba zigenga ubucuruzi Ingamba izo ari zo zose zigenga ubuhinzi, itangwa ry'ibyemezo n'ubucuruzi
articles.text:
by'ibikomoka ku moko y'ibihingwa
cyangwa iyoherezwa ryabyo hanze
y'igihugu cyangwa iyinjizwa ryabyo mu
gihugu ntibireba uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa kandi, uko byamera kose, izo
ngamba ntizigira ingaruka ku biteganywa
muri aya Masezerano y'Inyongera.

articles.heading: igihe uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa bumara (1) Uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
articles.text:
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa butangwa
mu gihe cy'imyaka makumyabiri (20)
uhereye ku itariki bwatangiweho,
havuyemo ibiti n'imizabibu, bitangirwa
uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa bumara igihe
cy'imyaka makumyabiri n’itanu (25)
uhereye ku itariki bwatangiweho.
(2) Hatitawe ku biteganywa mu gika cya
(1), igihe ubwoko bw'igihingwa
burengerwamo gishobora kwiyongeraho
indi myaka itanu, bimenyeshejwe Ibiro bya
ARIPO mu nyandiko, ku bijyanye
n'amatsinda y'amoko y'ibihingwa
n'inkomoko y'ibihingwa bimwe na bimwe.
IGICE CYA VIII: IZINA
RY'UBWOKO BW'IGIHINGWA

articles.heading: Izina ry'ubwoko bw'igihingwa (1) Ubwoko bw'igihingwa burangwa n'izina bwahawe
articles.text:
(a) rigaragaza umwimerere w'ibibugize
kandi ributandukanya n'ubundi:
(b) ntirishobora kuba rigizwe gusa
n'imibare, keretse ari bwo buryo
bwashyizweho mu rwego rwo gushyiraho
ibiranga ubwoko bw'igihingwa:
(c) ntirigomba gutuma habaho kwibeshya
cyangwa gutera urujijo ku gaciro
n'ibiranga ubwo bwoko bw’igihingwa,
cyangwa ku biranga uwabuvumbuye ;
(d) rigomba kuba ritandukanye n’irindi
zina iryo ari ryo ryose ryahawe ubwoko
bwariho mbere bikomoka ku gihingwa
kimwe cyangwa igisa neza n'icyo
bukomokaho ku butaka bw'ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano cyangwa
bw'ibihugu bigize umuryango
mpuzamahanga ushinzwe kurengera
amoko y'ibihingwa.
(2) Haseguriwe igika cya (5), nta
burenganzira bubuza gukoresha mu
bwisanzure izina ry'ubwoko bw'igihingwa
ryanditswe nk'iriburanga, nubwo igihe
cy'uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa cyaba
cyararangiye.
(3) Izina ry'ubwoko bw'igihingwa ritangwa
n'uwabuvumbuye mu Biro bya ARIPO
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 12.
(4) Mu gihe bigaragaye ko izina ritujuje
ibisabwa bivugwa mu gika cya (1)
cyangwa ryanditswe ku burenganzira
bwatanzwe mbere, Ibiro bya ARIPO
ntibigomba kuryandika kandi bigasaba
uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa gutanga irindi mu gihe
cyateganyijwe. Ibiro bya ARIPO byandika
izina mu gihe cyo gutanga uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa.
(5) Bitewe n'uburenganzira bwatanzwe
mbere, iyo umuntu, hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu gika cya (9), wagombye
gukoresha izina ry'ubwoko bw'igihingwa
yavumbuye atabyemerewe, Ibiro bya
ARIPO bimusaba gutanga irindi zina
ry'ubwo bwoko bw'igihingwa.
(6) Ubwoko bw'igihingwa muri iryo zina
bwahawe bugomba gushyikirizwa Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano, Ibiro bya
ARIPO ndetse n'ibihugu byose bigize
umuryango mpuzamahanga ushinzwe
kurengera amoko y'ibihingwa mu buryo
bwizewe.
(7) Ibiro bya ARIPO bigomba kwandika
iryo zina byahawe, keretse iyo bibonye ko
ritujuje ibisabwa, icyo gihe ibiro bya
ARIPO bisaba uwavumbuye ubwo bwoko
bushya gutanga irindi zina.
(8) Ibiro bya ARIPO bigomba kumenyesha
ubuyobozi bw'Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano ndetse n'ibihugu byose bigize
umuryango mpuzamahanga ushinzwe
kurengera amoko y'ibihingwa mu buryo
bwizewe, amakuru ku bibazo bijyanye
n'amazina yahawe amoko y'ibihingwa,
cyane cyane ku bijyanye n'itangwa
ry'amazina, kuyandika no kuyasiba.
(9) Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kiri muri aya
Masezerano cyangwa kigize umuryango
mpuzamahanga ushinzwe kurengera
amoko y'ibihingwa mu buryo bwizewe,
bishobora kumenyesha Ibiro bya ARIPO
icyo bitekereza ku iyandikwa ry'amazina,
niba gihari.
(10) Umuntu uwo ari we wese ushyize ku
isoko cyangwa ucuruza ibikoreshwa mu
butubuzi bw'ubwoko bw'igihingwa
burinzwe ku butaka bw'Ibihugu biri muri
aya Masezerano agomba gukoresha izina
ry'ubwo bwoko bw'igihingwa, nubwo igihe
cy'uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa bwatanzwe
kuri ubwo bwoko bw'igihingwa cyaba
cyararangiye, keretse iyo, hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu gika cya (5),
uburenganzira bwatanzwe mbere ku moko
y'ibihingwa butuma iryo zina
ridakoreshwa.
(11) Mu gihe ubwoko bw'igihingwa
bushyizwe ku isoko cyangwa bucuruzwa
butanzwe, biremewe guhuza izina ry'ubwo
bwoko ryanditswe n'ikirango cy'ubucuruzi,
izina ry'ubucuruzi cyangwa n'ikindi
kimenyetso, kandi iyo bihujwe muri ubwo
buryo, iryo zina rigomba kuba rishobora
kuboneka mu buryo bworoshye.
UMUTWE WA IX: GUTESHA
AGACIRO, GUSESA NO
KWIKURAHO UBURENGANZIRA
BW'UWAVUMBUYE UBWOKO
BUSHYA BW'IGIHINGWA

articles.heading: Gutesha agaciro uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa (1) Ibiro bya ARIPO bitangaza ko
articles.text:
uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa buteshejwe agaciro
igihe bigaragaye ko:
(a) ibisabwa biteganywa bivugwa mu
ngingo ya 7 n'iya 8 bitubahirijwe igihe cyo
gutanga uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa ; cyangwa
(b) Itangwa ry'uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa ryashingiye ahanini ku
makuru n'inyandiko byatanzwe
n'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa, kandi ibisabwa biteganywa
n'ingingo ya 9 cyangwa n'iya 10
bitarubahirijwe igihe cy'itangwa ry'ubwo
burenganzira; cyangwa
(c) uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa bwahawe
umuntu utabifitiye uburenganzira, keretse
bwarahawe umuntu ubwemerewe.
(2) Nta burenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa bushobora
guteshwa agaciro kubera izindi mpamvu
uretse izivugwa mu gika cya (1).

articles.heading: Gusesa uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa (1) Ibiro bya ARIPO bishobora gusesa
articles.text:
uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa:
(a) igihe bigaragaye ko ibisabwa
biteganywa n'ingingo ya 9 cyangwa n'iya
10 bitigeze byubahirizwa; cyangwa
(b) nyuma yo gusabwa kubyubahiriza
kandi mu gihe cyateganyijwe:
(i) Uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa atagejeje ku Biro bya ARIPO
amakuru, inyandiko cyangwa ibizwi
nk'ibikenerwa mu kugenzura ko ubwoko
bw'igihingwa bwujuje ibyangombwa,
cyangwa
(ii) uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa atishyura amafaranga
asabwa muri rusange kugira ngo
uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa bukomeze
kubahirizwa; cyangwa
(iii) mu gihe izina ry'ubwoko bw'igihingwa
ryateshejwe agaciro nyuma y'itangwa
ry'uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa,
uwabuvumbuye ntatange irindi zina
rikwiye.
(2) Uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw’igihingwa
ntibukurwaho ku mpamvu zindi uretse izo
zivugwa mu gika cya (1).

articles.heading: Kwikuraho uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa (1) Ufite uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
articles.text:
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa ashobora
kubwikuraho mbere yuko igihe cyabwo
kirangira, abimenyesheje Ibiro bya ARIPO
mu nyandiko.
(2) Itariki yabwikuyeho ni itariki yavuzwe
mu gihe cyo kubimenyesha cyangwa, mu
gihe ntayo yamenyekanishije, ikaba itariki
Ibiro bya ARIPO byakiriyeho inyandiko
ibimenyesha.
(3) Iyo habayeho kwikuraho uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa, icyemezo kigomba
gusubizwa Ibiro bya ARIPO.
UMUTWE WA X: IMPUSHYA

articles.heading: Impushya Ufite uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa ashobora kwemerera umuntu uwo ari we wese
articles.text:
uruhushya rwihariye cyangwa rudafite
umwihariko rwo gukoresha uburenganzira
bwose yahawe hakurikijwe umutwe wa VII
cyangwa igice cyabwo.
UMUTWE WA XI: GUTANGA NO
GUHEREREKANYA
UBURENGANZIRA
BW'UWAVUMBUYE UBWOKO
BUSHYA BW'IGIHINGWA

articles.heading: Gutanga no guhererekanya uburenganzira (1) Ubusabe bw'uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
articles.text:
bw'igihingwa cyangwa uburenganzira
bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw'igihingwa bishobora guhabwa undi
cyangwa guhererekanywa mu bundi buryo.
(2) Iryo tangwa cyangwa ihererekanya
bikorwa mu nyandiko ishyirwaho
umukono n'impande bireba kandi
bikandikwa mu gitabo.
UMUTWE WA XII: IKIGUZI

articles.heading: Ikiguzi Mu rwego rwo gushyira mu bikorwa aya Masezerano y'Inyongera hishyurwa amafaranga hakurikijwe urutonde
articles.text:
rw'ibiciro biteganywa mu mabwiriza
yemejwe hagendewe ku gaka ka (b) k'igika
cya (2) cy'ingingo ya 39.
UMUTWE WA XIII: KUJURIRIRA
IBYEMEZO NO KUBISHYIRA MU
BIKORWA

articles.heading: Ubujurire (1) Hashyizweho Urwego ruzwi nk' "Urwego rushinzwe ubujurire" (ni ukuvuga "ahakurikira rwiswe Urwego")
articles.text:
(2) Urwo Rwego rw'ubujurire rugizwe
n'abantu batanu (5) bafite uburambe mu
bijyanye no kurengera amoko y'ibihingwa,
aho babiri muri bo bagomba kuba bafite
ubuhanga mu bya tekiniki.
(3) Mu iterana rya buri nteko y’Urwego
hagomba kuba harimo nibura umwe muri
abo bafite ubuhanga mu bya tekiniki.
(4) Abagize Urwego rw'ubujurire
bashyirwaho n'Inama y’Ubutegetsi:
(a) mu gihe cy'imyaka ibiri ishobora
kongerwa inshuro imwe ikindi gihe
cy'imyaka ibiri ;
(b) baturuka mu Bihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera; kandi
(c) binyuze mu buryo cyangwa hagendewe
ku bisabwa bishobora kugenwa n'Inama
y’Ubutegetsi.
(5) Urwego rw'ubujurire rukora mu buryo
bukurikira:
(a) gusuzuma no gufatira ibyemezo
ubujurire ubwo ari bwo bwose bwatanzwe
n'usaba uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa cyangwa
n'ufite uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa bajuririra
icyemezo cyafashwe hifashishijwe igika
cya (1), icya (3) n'icya(4) by'ingigo ya 19,
iya (28) n'iya (29)
(b) kongera gusuzuma ibyemezo bya
nyuma byafashwe n'Ibiro bya ARIPO mu
rwego rw'ubuyobozi bijyanye n'ishyirwa
mu bikorwa ry'ibiteganywa muri aya
Masezerano y'Inyongera;
(c) gufata icyemezo ku kindi kibazo icyo
ari cyo cyose kiri mu bubasha bwarwo
cyangwa rushobora gufataho icyemezo.
(d) umubare ukenewe w'abagize Urwego
rw'ubujurire kugira ngo ruterane ni batatu.
(6) Ibyemezo byafashe n'Urwego
rw'ubujurire ntibyongera kujuririrwa.
(7) Urwego rw'ubujurire rufite ububasha
bwo gushyiraho no kwemeza amategeko
arugenga.

articles.heading: Ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'ibyemezo Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikora ibishoboka byose ku buryo
articles.text:
bishyiraho ingamba zo gushyira mu
bikorwa ibyemezo ndetse n'uburyo bwo
gukemura amakimbirane bwihariye kandi
bukwiye, ibihano ndetse n'uburyo bwo
kurenganura abarenganye mu rwego rwo
kubahiriza mu buryo bunoze
uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa no kwirinda ibindi
byose binyuranyije n'aya Masezerano
y'Inyongera.
UMUTWE WA XIV: INGINGO
RUSANGE

articles.heading: Iyongerwa ry'igihe cyagenwe (1) Iyo igihe cyagenwe kirangiye gishobora n'ubundi kongerwa, mu gihe
articles.text:
Ibiro bya ARIPO bibonye ko bifite
ishingiro bikurikije ibisobanuro byahawe.
(2) Ibiro bya ARIPO, bibisabwe mu
nyandiko, bishobora kongera, nyuma yo
gushyiraho ibisabwa bigomba
kubahirizwa, igihe cyagenewe gukora
igikorwa runaka cyangwa kuzuza ibisabwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa muri aya
Masezerano y'Inyongera cyangwa mu
Mabwiriza, bikamenyesha impande bireba
ibyemezo byafashe.

articles.heading: Ingaruka z’imikoreshereze imwe y'uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa mu turere
articles.text:
Uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw’'igihingwa bugira ingaruka
zimwe ku butaka bw’ibihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano bizwi aho uburenganzira
bw’uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya
bw’igihingwa bwatangiwe.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira imbere mu gihugu bw’uwavumbuye ubwoko bushya bw’igihingwa ku moko y’ibihingwa yavumbuye
articles.text:
Aya Masezerano y'Inyongera
ntabangamira uburenganzira bw'ibiihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bwo gutanga
uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye ubwoko
bushya bw'igihingwa imbere mu gihugu ku
moko y'ibihingwa byavumbuwe.
UMUTWE WA XV: AMABWIRIZA

articles.heading: Amabwiriza (1) Inama y’ubutegetsi ishyiraho amategeko agenga ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'aya Masezerano y'Inyongera kandi
articles.text:
ishobora kuyavugurura iyo bibaye
ngombwa.
(2) Amategeko areba by’umwihariko :
(a) ibisabwa n'ubuyobozi ibyo ari byo
byose, ibijyanye n'imikorere cyangwa
ubusobanuro bukenewe mu rwego rwo
gushyira mu bikorwa ibiteganywa n'aya
Masezerano y'Inyongera cyangwa
n'amasezerano mpuzamahanga ayo ari yo
yose bijyanye; na
(b) amafaranga agomba kwakirwa
n’uburyo bwo gusaranganya igice cyayo
hagati y’ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano.
UMUTWE WA XVI: INGINGO
ZISOZA

articles.heading: Gutangira gukurikizwa (1) Buri Gihugu kiri mu bigize ARIPO cyangwa Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose
articles.text:
cyemerewe kuba mu bigize ARIPO
gishobora kuba kimwe mu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano y'Inyongera:
(a) kiyashyiraho umukono bikurikirwa no
gutanga inyandiko iyemeza burundu;
cyangwa
(b) gitanga inyandiko yo kwemera kuba
kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho.
(2) Inyandiko ziyemeza burundu
n'inyandiko zemera kuba kimwe mu
bihugu biyahuriyeho zishyikirizwa
Umuyobozi Mukuru wa ARIPO.
(3) Aya Masezerano y'Inyongera atangira
gukurikizwa mu mezi cumi n’abiri nyuma
y’uko ibihugu bine bitanze inyandiko
ziyemeza burundu cyangwa inyandiko
zemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu
biyahuriyeho.
(4) Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kitari mu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano y'Inyongera
mu gihe atangiye gukurikizwa, gitangira
kugengwa na yo nyuma y'amezi atatu
uhereye ku itariki cyatangiyeho inyandiko
iyemeza burundu cyangwa yo kwemera
kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho.
(5) Binyuze mu nyandiko, Igihugu icyo ari
cyo cyose cyemeje burundu aya
Masezerano y'Inyongera cyangwa
kigasaba kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano y'Inyongera gifatwa
nk'ikigaragaza ko cyemera kugengwa
n'ibiteganywa mu Masezerano ashyiraho
Umuryango Nyafurika ugamije kurengera
Umutungo Bwite mu by'Ubwenge
(ARIPO) kandi icyo gihugu kiba ikigize
ARIPO ku itariki cyatangiyeho inyandiko
ziyemeza burundu cyangwa zemera kuba
kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho.

articles.heading: Ukwifata Nta kwifata gushobora gukorwa ku ngingo n'imwe y'aya Masezerano y'Inyongera
Gushyira umukono ku Masezerano y'Inyongera (1) Aya Masezerano y'Inyongera ashyizweho umukono mu nyandiko imwe
articles.text:
rukumbi kandi ishyikirijwe Umuyobozi
Mukuru wa ARIPO. Akomeza
kwemererwa gushyirwaho umukono
n'Ibihugu bigize Umuryango n’ibindi
bihugu bigize Umuryango wa Afurika
Yunze Ubumwe kugeza ku wa 31 Ukuboza
2015.
(2) Umuyobozi Mukuru wa ARIPO
yoherereza inyandukuro z'aya Masezerano
y'Inyongera, zihuje n’umwimerere w’aya
Masezerano y’Inyongera ibihugu
biyahuriyeho n’ibindi bihugu bigize
ARIPO kimwe n’ibihugu byemerewe kuba
bimwe mu bigize ARIPO hakurikijwe
ingingo ya IV y'Amasezerano ashyiraho
Umuryango Nyafurika ugamije kurengera
Umutungo Bwite mu by'Ubwenge
(ARIPO).

articles.heading: Ivugururwa ry'Amasezerano y'Inyongera (1) Aya Masezerano y'Inyongera ashobora kuvugururwa bisabwe n'Igihugu icyo ari
articles.text:
cyo cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano
cyangwa Umuyobozi Mukuru wa ARIPO,
mu Nteko z’ Inama y’Ubutegetsi.
(2) Kwemeza amavugururwa ku ngingo
iyo ari yo yose y’aya Masezerano
y’Inyongera bisaba ubwiganze bwa bibiri
bya gatatu by’amajwi y’ibihugu byose
biyahuriyeho.

articles.heading: Ukwivana mu Masezerano y'Inyongera (1) Igihugu icyo ari cyo cyose kiri muri aya Masezerano y'Inyongera gishobora
articles.text:
kuyivanamo nyuma yo kubimenysha
Umuyobozi Mukuru wa ARIPO.
(2) Ukwivana muri aya Masezerano
y'Inyongera bitangira gukurikizwa nyuma
y'amezi atandatu uhereye igihe Umuyobozi
Mukuru wa ARIPO yabinyesherejwe
kandi ntibibangamira ubusabe bwatanzwe
cyangwa uburenganzira bw'uwavumbuye
ubwoko bushya bw'igihingwa bwatanzwe
mbere y’uko ayo mezi atandatu arangira.
